preferred_style.name: Matt Pocock structured explainer
preferred_style.description: Left half pure black with structured explainer content (diagram, comparison, or fake UI mockup). Right half warm dark bedroom with Ray in black tee or white collared long-sleeve, Shure SM7B mic from bottom-right. Hand-drawn excalidraw font, colored rounded-square Kanban icons, red/green/orange semantic palette. 3 sub-families: structural, comparative, mockup.

global_feedback.facial_expressions: Keep expressions modest and natural — warm genuine smile, knowing smirk, or contemplative. NEVER exaggerated shock, surprise, or crazy reactions.
global_feedback.hairstyle: Don't make hair too curly or wavy — keep it naturally straight to match the reference photos exactly.
global_feedback.outfit: Black t-shirt OR plain white collared long-sleeve shirt only. No plaid, no beige, no patterns, no yellow, no graphic tees.
global_feedback.diagrams: Diagrams should look hand-drawn/excalidraw-style — NOT clean vector/polished boxes. Casual sketched quality.
global_feedback.matt_style_palette: Use 3-color semantic palette: red=old/bad, green=new/good, orange=hero highlight. White/gray for neutral labels.
global_feedback.matt_style_accents: Red curved hand-drawn arrow used exactly ONCE per thumbnail. Yellow handwritten (parenthetical) annotation used sparingly. Bold white-on-black pill callout optional.
global_feedback.anti_patterns: Never use: metaphor illustrations (cameras, bells, zzz clouds, cartoons), giant single-word typography as only element, crossed-out/X-marked commands, retro pixel terminal, chaos grids, scatter plots, dense >6-item compositions.
